description: Land Acquisition - Walahandoowa, Akmeemana D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing a parcel of land (2.0234 Hectare) to be acquired for public purpose. It includes details about the land's location, description, and procedures for interested parties to claim compensation. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition and property matters.
